positions.name: OwnedVsRented
positions.frame: what distinguishes owned intelligence from rented intelligence?
positions.why: src-1 asserts the core distinction between owned and rented intelligence; src-2 specifies the mechanism — substrate is commodity, perspective is the retained asset. Both cohere under the question of what separates owned from rented, with src-2 supplying the concrete axis (substrate vs perspective) that src-1 leaves open.
